case.name: Elnathan

A.name: Elnathan
A.line: from Jerusalem, father of Nehushta (2KI 24:8), an official (JER 36:12)

kjv.2KI 24:8: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
kjv.JER 26:22: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.
kjv.JER 36:12: Then he went down into the king's house, into the scribe's chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
kjv.JER 36:25: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll: but he would not hear them.

B.name: Elnathan
B.line: Of Jerusalem; father of Nehushta, maternal grandfather of king Jehoiachin.

kjv.2KI 24:8: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

disputed_verses.BHSA 2KI 24:8: בֶּן־שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יְהֹויָכִ֣ין בְּמָלְכֹ֔ו וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמֹּ֔ו נְחֻשְׁתָּ֥א בַת־אֶלְנָתָ֖ן מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
disputed_verses.KJV 2KI 24:8: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

first_reader_said: 2KI 24:8: Both records are Elnathan of Jerusalem, father of Nehushta.

why: Both records identify Elnathan of Jerusalem as Nehushta’s father in 2KI 24:8; B contains no separate lineage, family, or occurrence. A additionally identifies him as Achbor’s son and a royal official under Jehoiakim (JER 26:22; 36:12, 25), which is compatible with that family and period. B is a thinner copy of A, whose family ties and verse coverage are fuller.
